subject: NATIONAL-OF function
notes: REFUTED IN TEST-REF ONLY; the verdict SURVIVES attack and stays CONFORMS. I re-rendered the page myself rather than inheriting the prior pass's rendering (`clause_page.py 15.66.2` -> PDF page 922 / printed folio 892; `render-spec-page.py 922`): the printed format is `FUNCTION NATIONAL-OF ( argument-1 [ argument-2 ] )`, FUNCTION and NATIONAL-OF UNDERLINED, argument-2 BRACKETED, NO comma and no third element - the specs/ISO_COBOL.md transcription is faithful. I then attacked the one spelling the prior pass never tried, and which the printed diagram makes canonical: the SPACE separator. It works, and it works for the right reason - `functionArgList : functionArgument (FNARG_SEPARATOR? functionArgument)*` makes the separator optional, so the space-separated list genuinely SPLITS rather than being swallowed (proved with diagnostics, not with a value, because argument-2 is semantically inert and an output probe could not tell the two parses apart). Result reference modification (§8.4.3.3.3 SR2, a national-type function) also works.
